lines.en: A similar place at a similar time calls for a similar intro to the one you just got.
Just, this time, we’ll talk about something a little different from “responsibility.”
This time, we’ll talk about jealousy.
Maya Makinami was a normal high school girl. Well, kind of. Actually, not really. Like, she was normal-ish. Especially now that her brain was a brain again.
But she still enjoyed the way a specific adult male’s phallus felt inside of her, so she was about to embark on a journey to feel that again as that man was currently not being much of a man at all.

She was angry because of this. He’d ignored her before, but this time was different. And she wasn’t sure if Ami had anything to do with it, but she knew she’d have to confront her too as a part of this journey.
That’s not who she was jealous of, though.
Her actual jealousy was focused at three other people. But, on the bright side, one of those people was dead.
: Maya?...
But two of them weren’t.
And one of them just so happens to be the real subject for event numero dos.
Which, unfortunately, means Mayonnaise Macaroni is going to have to wait a little longer to be the center of attention again. But hey, she should be used to that by now.
Or...shouldn’t be?
I don’t know. Do you think she’s retained any of her memories?
Or do you think that maybe she’s kind of always just been a bitch?
: What are you doing?
: Uhh...
: Fuck. I thought if I stayed really still, you wouldn’t be able to see me.
: Are you some kind of chameleon?
: It takes one to know one, you slimy whore.
: Reptiles aren’t slimy. That’s more of an amphibian thing. If anything, chameleons feel more leathery than-
: Why are you talking to me? Why are you looking at me? I’m clearly busy.
: Busy doing what? Because it’s sports day and it looks kind of like you’re getting ready to leave.
: Well, aren’t you just an expert at deductive reasoning?
: You’re just going to leave your friends behind when they’re counting on you? Seriously?
Despite directly asking Maya about her intentions, Noriko already knew the answer.
She just preferred to look to the positive side of things, and sincerely hoped her “rival” would see the errors of her ways if they were just pointed out to her enough.
But that wasn’t the type of girl her “rival” was.
: They’ll figure out a way to win without me. It’s no big deal.
Her rival was selfish. Stubborn. She was simple-minded, yet passionate to a point where it felt almost like some sort of over-exaggerated character flaw.

But despite feeling the negativity oozing out of those unfortunate traits, Noriko was jealous of her as well. And she frequently wondered what it would be like to not assume the role of a martyr every morning.

This is what made the two rivals in the first place — that mutual jealousy and unspoken respect, pumped with negative connotations that seemed more like embalming fluid the longer it kept their hatred from decaying.
: Then, do you mind if I take a guess as to where you’re going?
It would have to decay eventually, though...wouldn’t it?
: I do, actually. I’ve already had to fend off one interrogation today and I’d much prefer to not go over my quota.
After all, the two of them weren’t all that different from one another.
They loved the same man. They were interested in the same avant-garde literature. Even their Internet histories were mostly congruous.
But, most importantly of all, they shared the same fear — each other.
Right now, one of them was terrified.
And the other was simply...
Nostalgic.
: Hah...
: Does that sigh mean I’m free to go now? Or are you planning on telling Miss Imai about this the second I walk through those doors?
: I’m not going to tell on you, Maya. And I doubt Imani would give a shit even if I did.
: I’m sighing because I’m disappointed.
: And...I’m supposed to care about that?
: No...I just mean that it sucks you’ve managed to make it this far without finding even one more thing you want to protect.
: You want to know what sucks even more? A creepy stalker who transfers into my school so she can try and fuck my teacher. That sucks. And it goes against what we agreed. So die.
: We were kids, Maya. We said and agreed to a lot of things we didn’t understand.
: But not all of us did things we didn’t understand.
: So, when you and Akira are alone, what’s it like?
: We’re supposed to call him “Sensei.”
: Ugh! You’re gonna make me do that too? It’s bad enough hearing it from him all the time. The last thing I need is you hopping on the same bandwagon of boredom.
: Can you please stop talking now? I’m trying to study.
: But we’re supposed to be studying together.
: Sure. But I don’t want to study together. You never take anything seriously and you talk way too much. It’s annoying. You’re annoying. So die.
: Why do you always have to be so mean to me? I’m just trying to make conversation.

: No, you’re trying to make weird conversation about Sensei and me being alone together. It’s a leading question and I’m not going to fall into whatever trap allows you to extort information out of me.
: Maya, you’re here every day. I can only come once or twice a week. You guys are alone a lot. And even when I’m here, you’re always getting special treatment.
: I’m getting special treatment? You keep calling him by his given name and he’s never even disciplined you for it. And that's not even counting how you’re always hanging all over him.
: I’ve been hanging all over him since I was a baby. He’s basically my big brother. And he’s probably going to be my big brother one day if he and my sister get married.
: If. Key word.
: Would you rather it be you?
: If I say yes, will you stop talking to me?
: No. I’ll probably press you even harder about what happens when you guys are alone.
: Then I guess I’ll just shut my own mouth since you seem incapable of doing that.
: Wanna know what he does with my sister when they’re alone?
: They haven’t been “alone” for months. She’s a non-factor. And also, no. Because I would like to keep my lunch inside of my body.
: She gives him “handjobs.” Do you know what those are, Maya? It’s when-
: I don’t need you to tell me what they are! I’m not an idiot!
: Ooooooh? So you know already? Is that what you’re reading about over there? Practicing for having a boyfriend one day? No wonder why you want to study alone.
: It’s only a matter of time until we start doing stuff like that, isn’t it?
: Do you think Akira might teach us about sex-ed next?
: Shut up...
: I’m pretty sure there are other “jobs” too. I heard one of the girls in my class talking about “blowjobs” but I don’t think I get it yet. Like, do you just-
: Shut up!
: Jeez, Maya. You don’t have to yell at me.
: Shut up!
: Jeez, Maya. You don’t have to yell at me.
: How can I not when you’re always such a presumptuous cunt?! You don’t know the first thing about what I did back then!
: I mean...I might not have seen it. But the context clues at this point from both of you are no longer just a pile. It’s kind of like a big context...mountain.
: So what, then? Are you jealous? Are you just stopping me because you’re still petty about the way things ended up? You wish it were you instead?
: Maya...I am jealous about a lot of things.
: Your eyes....Your figure...Your confidence...
: There are so many parts of you that I want for myself.
: But being molested is not one of them.
: You have no fucking clue what you’re talking about.
: Now, if you’re done ruining my life, I would like to leave you with the same words I left Ayane with.
: Peace.
: And also, die.
: Oh and good fucking luck or whatever. Hope you’re chosen for death ball.
: Death ball?
: What the hell is death ball?
: Hey, welcome back. I was beginning to think you weren’t going to join us this year. Which was kind of weird on account of how we walked to school together.
: Yeah, I had to show my friends around. And then I had to get dressed. And then I had to confront a ghost from my past who still haunts the halls of this very school.
: Cool. I had tacos.
: I want tacos. How come you always get to have all the fun while I’m stuck conquering demons?
: Because I’ve dedicated my life to doing whatever I want and you’ve dedicated yours to making other people happy for whatever reason.
: If you’ve dedicated your life to doing whatever you want, how come you’re not a stay-at-home mom packing lunches for our former teacher yet?
: Stay-at-home mom? Oh, please. I’m just going to be the live-in housekeeper who fucks him while the wife is away and occasionally joins in for threesomes.
: Does this mean I get to be the wife?!
: You’re probably the most likely to have a consensual threesome with me at this point, so yeah. Looks like you get to be the wife.
: And every Tuesday can be Taco Tuesday?!
: And every Tuesday can be Taco Tuesday.
: I’ve never been more excited to share the love of my life before. And that’s saying a lot because I do that every single day now.
: Thankfully, everyone you’re normally sharing him with is here. Minus the crazy niece and Yumi, that is.
: Yumi will be here. I texted her earlier.
: There’s someone else missing now, though. The first floor just lost Maya. And I highly doubt she’ll be coming back any time soon.
: Maya? Is that who you were talking about with that whole “ghost from your past” thing? The fuck is she doing bailing on the contest before it’s even gotten started?
: Probably attempting the same thing you’ve been desperately holding yourself back from doing over the last few months in storming Sensei’s castle and attempting to claim his heart.
: On bloomer day? Lame. I only got to stare at her ass for like two minutes.
: You can stare at my ass next. I think it’s a pretty good one.
: Yeah, but I see yours all the time. Maya’s ass is like filet mignon in that I rarely ever get to experience it and when I do, I want to take my time and enjoy it.
: Maya is technically my rival and I should be mad at you for saying this, but yeah. I get it.
: You sure you’re okay with staying here, though? Because I wouldn’t blame you for chasing after her given that you are rivals and all.
: There’s no point. I can never beat her head-to-head. She’s got too much of a lead.
: Yeah, but you’ve also been saying all that shit about how she’s been different lately. So maybe that won’t vibe with Sensei and he’ll decide he wants to fuck you more or something.
: I don’t know. I’m trying to think positive here.
: All things considered, this is probably the least weird thing she’s done lately. Doesn’t mean it isn’t annoying, though.
: Mood. Karin’s been like that lately too.
: Karin? Like...like the Karin?
: The one who shares my DNA? Yeah.
: Well, what the fuck happened to her?! She can’t act weird! She’s our perfect little ball of sunshine!
: First off, fuck you. But second, I have no fucking clue!
: She just came home bawling her eyes out one day and won’t tell me what happened. She’s barely left the bedroom outside of going to school.
: I hope she didn’t see an animal get run over or something. I feel like that would greatly alter her path and turn her into something none of us are ready to console.
: No, I don’t think that’s it. This seems more, like...personal. She’d tell me about an animal getting hurt.
: It’s just...weird. I’ve never had to deal with her keeping a secret before, so I can’t really wrap my head around what it might be.
: Do you think someone might have confessed to her again or something?
: I don’t know. Maybe she finally found out what a dick is and just can’t mentally process it?
: Your sister knows what is a dick is, Kirin.
: You can never be sure when it comes to things like this, Noriko. And if anyone knows about my sister’s history with dicks, it’s me.
: I want to say that’s weird, but I can also completely relate.
: Okay, okay, okay! Eyes over here, girls!
